title: Which Objectives Need a Dial? Predicting Objective Conflict and Covering Trade-offs in Steerable Pluralistic Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on pluralistic alignment and balancing conflicting objectives (such as helpfulness, verbosity, and safety) in LLMs using Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization (MODPO). It does not explicitly evaluate, measure, or benchmark religion, moral philosophy, normative ethics, or spiritual traditions.
